crossRefs.note: Moses begged Yahweh his God, and said, “Yahweh, why does your wrath burn hot against your people, that you have brought…
Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.
The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.
They came to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the princes, saying, “Yahweh commanded Moses to…

translations.web: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give to us a possession among the brothers of our father.”
translations.bsb: Why should the name of our father disappear from his clan because he had no sons? Give us property among our father’s brothers.”
translations.kjv: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he hath no son? Give unto us therefore a possession among the brethren of our father.
translations.asv: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give unto us a possession among the brethren of our father.
